claim_scope: Transductive reconstruction from exposed offsets; no superiority or recursive-hierarchy claim
primary_endpoint: Fraction of clean identifiable pair queries agreeing with truth and both references within Euclidean displacement error 1e-5
disconnected_rule: Every cross-component query must return UNIDENTIFIABLE
contradiction_rule: Noisy/inconsistent residual remains positive; independently evaluated committed energy agrees with least squares within 1e-8
selection_rule: No fitting or parameter selection in C0; settings predeclared and identical across all worlds
observability: Only opaque IDs and exposed numerical offsets/weights; hidden coordinates/edges/queries remain evaluator-owned
reset_policy: New zero-initialized geometry per world; freeze before queries; no cross-world learned parameters
feedback_rules: No hidden answer feedback to candidate
query_rule: All eight hidden redundant edges are included among 64 indirect queries; exposed-pair diagnostics and cross-component queries are separate panels
historical_receipts: R001: evidence/c0_original; R002: evidence/c0_review_interrupted (stopped for additional qualification repair, not accepted); R003 uses disjoint fresh seeds
stationarity_rule: Both absolute free-node force and force divided by exposed weighted degree must be below the registered gradient tolerance; additional guard prevents tiny weights from falsely certifying wrong coordinates
